first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, directly matching prior evidence that shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields improved completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation. Verify both archived records before committing, then run a guarded test to confirm the lift produces qualified, retained usage rather than only faster completion. Avoid promotional pricing because its acquisition and revenue gains materially harmed 30-day retention.
